text:
anya: seeing intermittent linkcheck failures on mkdocs CI for /guides/sdk — the fragment '#configure-client' 404s sometimes on windows runner.
anya: output snippet:
```text
LinkCheckError: Broken fragment: /guides/sdk#configure-client
  at check_fragment (linkcheck.py:42)
  at run_check (ci-job:81)
```
matt: odd, only on windows? linux runs green?
ci-bot: CI job https://ci.redwood.example/run/7821 failed (linkcheck) — reproducer attached
sam: i've seen this before when heading slug normalization differs because of smart quotes or soft-hyphen. mkdocs slugify varies by runtime env.
olivia: can you paste the heading in the page's md? might be a nonbreaking space or unicode char
anya: here's the header block from docs/guides/sdk.md
```md
### Configure­ Client
```
anya: note there's a soft-hyphen (U+00AD) between Configure and Client — explains the inconsistent slug
matt: ugh. iirc docusaurus and mkdocs handle that differently. quick options:
- strip soft-hyphens in pre-build step
- add explicit id: `### Configure Client {#configure-client}`
- normalize slugify by forcing ascii/fold in mkdocs config
sam: i'd vote explicit id for the short term. patch attached:
```diff
@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@
-### Configure­ Client
+### Configure Client {#configure-client}
```
olivia: can someone raise a tiny PR to apply that across affected pages? i can review.
anya: i'll open a PR for sdk pages and add a small grep+sed in CI to fail when U+00AD present
matt: +1 on CI check. sample grep to detect:
```bash
# fail if soft-hyphen exists
if git grep -I --line-number $'\xC2\xAD' -- '*.md'; then
  echo "found soft-hyphen in docs"
  exit 1
fi
```
ci-bot: noted — created issue https://issues.redwood.example/456 (docs: detect invisible hyphen in build)
docs-bot: Suggestion: Batch PR to replace soft-hyphen with normal space and add explicit ids where necessary
sam: ok i'll make the batch PR for all pages under docs/guides and include the CI check
olivia: thanks — add yourself as assignee and ping #release-war-room if it needs fast deploy
anya: thx everyone. will watch the PR and merge when green. :thumbsup:
